main_text.p: se applicuerat, contra Judæorum fere o-mnium consvetudinem, bene multa de Maforetharum arte ei indicavit, quæ vi-debantur abstrusissima & à paucissimis etiam Judæis intellecta, sed non est, cur diutius his detinear, cum Indicis illius o-puscula edenda sint in lucem à Presbyte-ris Congregationis Oratorii Parisiensis: qvi Catalogum illum publici juris fece-runt. Miratus sum profecto, & ab his ad-junctas non fuisse huic Indici Epistolas, qvas mihi benignè communicavit ejus-dem Societatis Presbyter Clarissimus A-melotut; sed ut audio, in varias partes scis-si sunt Congregationis illius homines, i-biqve reperitur discordia trà santi offici è messi. His etiam adjici potuissent varia constitutionum genera ad qvas respon-disse fertur Morinus, multaqve illarum exemplaria penes Amelorum extant & in musæo illius asservantur; ferunt etiam, Morinum scripsisse de Baptismo & de Matrimonio, virqve è primariis illius Congregationis certiorem me fecit, se vidisse intra manus ejusdem Morini

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "o-mnium" (the first letter of line 2 is faint); "Amelotut" (possibly Amelotum); "trà santi offici è messi" (italic, "santi" and "offici" doubtful); "Amelorum" on the next line. A stray mark stands before "Presbyteris" (printed "à ¦Presbyte-"), possibly a printer's sign. The bottom-right corner has a faint digitiser mark, which was left out. The right side of the scan shows only shadow and stains.
